translation.question: Kimbunga Erick kiliweka rekodi gani ya hali ya hewa kuhusu kuwasili kwake kwenye pwani yoyote ya Mexico?
translation.expected_answer: kimbunga kikubwa cha mapema zaidi kwenye rekodi kufika nchi kavu
translation.translation_note: Translated 'meteorological record' to 'rekodi ya hali ya hewa' and 'make landfall' to 'kufika nchi kavu'.

backtranslation_en.question: What weather record did Hurricane Erick set regarding its arrival on any coast of Mexico?
backtranslation_en.expected_answer: earliest major hurricane on record to make landfall
